cases.about: Board memo, ~580 words: header table, rule, 5 headings, 5 lists, a captioned table, a callout; first-page letterhead band with a logo, running header and footer.

runs.text: Q3 2026 results and the revised capital plan

Revenue for the third quarter came in at $4.82 million, 6% ahead of plan and 18% above the same quarter last year. The improvement was driven almost entirely by the enterprise segment, where three renewals closed earlier than forecast. Gross margin held at 61.4%, within half a point of the prior quarter despite higher hosting costs in September. Operating expenses rose 4% quarter on quarter, mainly from the two senior engineering hires approved in June.

We are asking the board to approve the revised capital plan, which re-phases two projects into the first half of 2027. Neither project changes in total cost; the re-phasing moves $310,000 of spend out of the current financial year.

Customer churn fell to 1.9% for the quarter, the lowest rate since the pricing change took effect. The pipeline for the fourth quarter stands at $6.1 million, weighted, with 40% of it in late-stage negotiation. Two risks deserve the board's attention: a single customer now accounts for 14% of revenue, and hiring in the data team remains slow. Management recommends no change to the full-year guidance until the October renewals are signed.
Two engineering hires started in July

Two risks deserve the board's attention: a single customer now accounts for 14% of revenue, and hiring in the data team remains slow. Management recommends no change to the full-year guidance until the October renewals are signed. The audit committee reviewed the revenue recognition for multi-year contracts and found no exceptions.
Customer concentration: one customer is 14% of revenue
A competitor cut list prices by 15%

We are asking the board to approve the revised capital plan, which re-phases two projects into the first half of 2027. Neither project changes in total cost; the re-phasing moves $310,000 of spend out of the current financial year. We expect the remaining integration work on the billing platform to finish by mid-November, two weeks later than planned.
Project Atlas moves to Q1 2027 (owner: COO, decision by 15 November)
Project Beacon moves to Q2 2027 (owner: CTO, decision by 30 November)

The finance team will circulate the detailed management accounts, including the cost-centre breakdown, a week before the meeting. We expect the remaining integration work on the billing platform to finish by mid-November, two weeks later than planned. Any questions on this memo should go to the Office of the CFO before Thursday, so that answers can be prepared in advance. Revenue for the third quarter came in at $4.82 million, 6% ahead of plan and 18% above the same quarter last year.
Board approves the revised capital plan
CFO circulates management accounts by 8 November
Audit committee reports at the December meeting
